epics.title: Platform foundation, auth and roles
epics.description: Solution skeleton, PostgreSQL, authentication, the three roles, teacher-subject assignment, audit logging. PRD §3, §14, §15, §16.

stories.title: Bootstrap backend solution (.NET 10, DDD/CQRS, PostgreSQL)
stories.description: As a developer I need a runnable API skeleton so that every later story has a home. PRD §18.
tasks: Create solution from the DDD template: Api, Application, Domain, Infrastructure, Tests
Add PostgreSQL via EF Core 10 with Npgsql, JSONB support and migrations pipeline
Configure MediatR pipeline: validation, logging, unit-of-work behaviours
Add health endpoint, Swagger, structured logging, and environment config
Add CI workflow: restore, build, test, vulnerability scan

stories.title: Bootstrap frontend app (React, TypeScript, Vite, RTL)
stories.description: As a developer I need the SPA skeleton with Arabic RTL, routing and API client so that screens can be added feature by feature.
tasks: Scaffold Vite React TS app with Tailwind and shadcn/ui
Configure i18next with Arabic default, RTL direction and Arabic-Indic digit formatting
Set up TanStack Query and Orval codegen from the API's OpenAPI spec
Add React Hook Form and Zod base form components
Add layout shells for Student, Teacher and Admin with role-based route guards

stories.title: Authentication with phone OTP and email
stories.description: As a student I can sign up and log in with my phone number or email so that my progress is saved. PRD §7.1.
tasks: User aggregate: id, role, phone, email, display name, status
Register and login commands with OTP provider abstraction (SMS gateway to be chosen)
JWT issuance with refresh tokens and role claims
Rate limiting on OTP requests and login attempts
Frontend: sign up, OTP verify, login, logout screens

stories.description: As the platform I enforce the permission matrix server-side so that a teacher can only act on assigned subjects. PRD §16.
tasks: Authorization policies per role applied to every endpoint
TeacherSubject entity and admin commands to assign/unassign subjects
Subject-scope filter behaviour that rejects any teacher request outside assigned subjects
Integration tests: physics teacher cannot read or mutate math content
Frontend: hide navigation the current role cannot use

stories.title: Audit log for content and validation actions
stories.description: As an admin I can see who changed what and when so that content disputes can be resolved. PRD §14, §17 rule 13.
tasks: AuditLog entity and append-only repository
Domain event handler that writes an audit row for content changes and validation decisions
Query with filters: actor, entity type, date range
Admin audit log page with pagination

epics.title: Content tree management

Create, update, reorder, delete commands with validators
List and detail queries including counts of lessons and questions
Admin UI: subject list, unit list with drag or up/down reorder

Image upload endpoint to object storage with size and type limits
LaTeX rendering support in the rich text editor and viewer
Admin UI: lesson editor with objectives list editing and preview

Published_at tracking and domain events for downstream servable recalculation
Student queries filter to published lessons only
Admin UI: publish/archive actions with confirmation

Test-answer box that calls the real grading endpoint
